title: Kingston NV2 2TB NVMe M.2 2280 SSD $159.00 + Delivery @ Mwave
body:

[AmirSp] We ordered a Ubiquiti device almost three weeks ago. It was initially listed as in stock with the supplier, but after a long delay, we cancelled the order and placed a new one for an item that was available. Previous orders are still not visible in the system, so I can’t confirm exactly when the order was placed.
Then the website migration took place, and we couldn’t get a response or contact anyone. We have now received an email offering a $50 compensation payment, so I replied and requested a full refund. However, someone else responded saying that they are preparing the order for us.
It has been a complete mess, and it seems no one knows what is happening.

The Kingston NV2 2TB is an older budget PCIe 4.0 SSD. On paper it looks decent:
2TB
PCIe 4.0 ×4
Up to 3,500 MB/s read
Up to 2,800 MB/s write
640 TBW endurance
M.2 2280
3-year warranty
The catch is important: Kingston changed the controller/NAND hardware between production batches without changing the model number. That means two NV2s can perform differently. Tom’s Hardware specifically criticised this variability, along with relatively poor sustained performance and heat.
